resources.string: Your To-Do is due now. This alarm is for its scheduled reminder.
Your snoozed To-Do reminder is due now.
Stop silences this alarm only. The task stays pending and future repeats remain scheduled. Sound stops automatically after 2 minutes.
At the due time, To-Do alarms ring with Snooze and Stop controls. Allow full-screen access and exact alarms for timely alerts. Android may show a banner while you are using the phone.
